seeded_chaos.generator: deterministic Python random.Random(seed) permutations with dependency deferral

invariants.replica_verification: Read-back digest and version verification reaches exactly the desired replica count.
invariants.wal_idempotency: Committed WAL recovery delivers one effect and a second recovery produces no duplicate effects.
invariants.deletion: Tombstoned GraphRAG content is absent from rebuilt projections and later active versions are rejected.
invariants.cache_and_index: The stale exact cache binding is invalidated while cache and GraphRAG expose the committed version.
invariants.partial_placement: A failed bucket placement either compensates immediately or leaves a durable, recoverable receipt.
invariants.provider_capability: Unsupported storage capability returns a typed unsupported result and cannot fall back.
